sentences.text: Luckky Masih vs State Of Uttarakhand on 12 December, 2024

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 First Bail Application No. 1752 of 2024
Luckky Masih ........Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Present:-
Mr. Mukul Singh Dangi, Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, D.A.G. for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

Applicant is in judicial custody in Special Sessions Trial No. 133 of 2023, in Case Crime No. 287 of
2023, under Section 376 (3), 506 Ipc and Section 5 (l)/6 of the Protection of Children From Sexual
Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Nehru Colony, District Dehradun.

He has sought his release on
bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the applicant was staying in the house of the informant with regard to his work.
He raped the victim, who is daughter of the informant on multiple occasions on various dates.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the victim has already been examined in the trial.
The parties had enmity.
The informant was not happy with the applicant.
Therefore, false FIR has been lodged.
5. Learned State counsel would submit that the victim has already been examined.
She has supported the prosecution case.
The medical report also supports the prosecution case.
6. It is the stage of bail.
Much of the discussion is not expected of.
Arguments are being appreciated with the caveat that any observation made in this order shall have no bearing at any subsequent stage of the trial or in any other proceedings.
7. The victim has supported the prosecution case at trial.
She has also proved her statement under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, in which also she has supported the prosecution case.
8. Having considered the entirety of facts, this Court is of the view that there is no ground to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application deserves to be rejected.
